children: Canada learning commerce platform's Q3 revenue rose 2% yr/yr, beating analyst expectations
Company posted $3.8 mln net loss, reflecting $4.1 mln in restructuring costs
Thinkific Plus segment revenue grew 18%, offsetting decline in Self-Serve segment
Thinkific expects Q4 2026 revenue of $18.9 mln to $19.2 mln
Company expects Q4 adjusted EBITDA margin of 20%-25%
PLUS SEGMENT GROWTH - Thinkific said strong performance in its Plus segment drove revenue growth, with Plus Subscription and Commerce revenue up 18% yr/yr
SELF-SERVE DECLINE - Self-Serve Subscription and Commerce revenue fell 3% yr/yr, partially offsetting overall growth
RESTRUCTURING COSTS - Company swung to a $3.8 mln net loss after recording $4.1 mln in restructuring costs tied to its September reorganization
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "hold" and the breakdown of recommendations is 1 "strong buy" or "buy", 3 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the software peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Thinkific Labs Inc is C$2.46, about 17.8% above its November 2 closing price of C$2.09
